subject: Re: Kickoff: JaxSel subgraph extraction as a retrieval primitive
body:
Anders,

Staffing plan for the next two months:

- Efe Lindqvist is committed to us at 60% for all of May 2026 to own the Agent-model training loop — I've blocked that in the allocation sheet. He's the only one who has touched the implicit weighted-adjacency code, so this is the critical fraction.
- Rafael 50% on the sparse selection layer and its gradient stability.
- Nikhil 40% on the 10M-node synthetic graph harness.
- Kaia 30% advisory, mostly reviewing the eval design.

Compute is modest: Titan A100 best-effort covers pathfinder reproduction; I'll only go to Ines if the 10M-node runs need dedicated nodes. One dependency to note: run.sh clones the long-range-arena repo at setup, and our build mirrors don't have it yet — Nikhil is registering it with the artifact cache this week so CI doesn't hit the network.

Alina
